outcomes.intended_user_result: Native OMP recall attachments retain enough trace and coverage metadata to reconcile prepared context with the service retrieval decision.
outcomes.current_baseline: buildRecallAttachment emits recalled statements and provenance but drops trace_id and considered/matched/included accounting.
outcomes.acceptance: Nonempty attachments include trace identity and bounded included/matched counts when provided; hit content and provenance remain unchanged; empty results remain empty; no unauthorized identifiers are added.

excluded_scope: No retrieval ranking, scoring, scope, provenance, or budget policy change.
No model, vector, graph, MCP, connector, external backend, schema, or database migration.
No live data rewrite or native OMP configuration change.
No remote publication without new explicit authorization for R5.

allowed_actions: create GitHub release with verified artifact

next_authorized_goal_ref: Horizon Relay after a concrete workflow is selected
